lemma appIso_inv_appLE_apply (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w] {V V' : Z.Opens}
    (e : V' ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (s : Γ(Z, V)) :
    (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) V' e).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      = (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by rwa [w.preimage_image_eq] at e)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_appLE]

/-- **Germ regularity transports along the immersion section transport**: if all germs
of `s` on `V` are nonzerodivisors, so are all germs of the transported section on the
image open `w ''ᵁ V` — the stalk comparison of an open immersion is an isomorphism. -/
theorem germ_appIso_inv_mem_nonZeroDivisors (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w]
    {V : Z.Opens} {s : Γ(Z, V)}
    (hs : ∀ (z : Z) (hz : z ∈ V),
      (Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z))
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ w ''ᵁ V) :
    (Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) y hy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hzy : w.base z ∈ w ''ᵁ V := (Scheme.Hom.apply_mem_image_iff w).mpr hz
  -- push the germ through the stalk comparison of the immersion
  have hpush : (w.stalkMap z).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) (w.base z) hzy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s))
      = (Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_app_apply]
    rw [show eqToHom (w.preimage_image_eq V)
        = homOfLE (w.preimage_image_eq V).le from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    rw [Z.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  -- transfer nonzerodivisibility along the stalk isomorphism
  set e := (asIso (w.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  have hval : (Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) (w.base z) hzy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      = e.symm ((Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s) := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hpush
  have hmem := equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors e.symm (hs z hz)
  rw [← hval] at hmem
  exact hmem

/-- **Open-immersion unit descent, section form** (the S4
`exists_unit_of_pullback_unit` engine freed of the `LocalEquations` carrier,
`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): a unit relation between the `appLE` pullbacks of two
sections `a`, `b` on an open `V` below both preimages descends to a unit relation
between their restrictions on the image open `w ''ᵁ V`.  The unit is the inverse
transport of `v` through the section retraction of the immersion
(`Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv`); the identity is checked after pulling back to
`w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)`, where pullback of sections is bijective. -/
theorem exists_unit_res_of_appLE_eq_unit_mul (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w]
    {U₁ U₂ : Y.Opens} (a : Γ(Y, U₁)) (b : Γ(Y, U₂)) {V : Z.Opens}
    (hV₁ : V ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ U₁) (hV₂ : V ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ U₂)
    (hW₁ : w ''ᵁ V ≤ U₁) (hW₂ : w ''ᵁ V ≤ U₂) (v : Γ(Z, V)ˣ)
    (hv : (w.appLE U₁ V hV₁).hom a = (v : Γ(Z, V)) * (w.appLE U₂ V hV₂).hom b) :
    ∃ u : Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V)ˣ,
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a
        = (u : Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V)) * (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b := by
  have hWrange : w ''ᵁ V ≤ w.opensRange := w.image_le_opensRange V
  have hpre : w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V) ≤ V := (w.preimage_image_eq V).le
  haveI := Scheme.Hom.isIso_appLE_of_le_opensRange w hWrange
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv w hWrange).symm (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v), ?_⟩
  -- restrict the pulled relation to the preimage of the image open
  have h₁ : (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom ((w.appLE U₁ V hV₁).hom a)
      = (w.appLE U₁ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₁)).hom a := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  have h₂ : (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom ((w.appLE U₂ V hV₂).hom b)
      = (w.appLE U₂ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₂)).hom b := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  have hres := congrArg (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom hv
  rw [map_mul, h₁, h₂] at hres
  -- both restricted sections pull back to `appLE` of the originals
  have e₁ : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a)
      = (w.appLE U₁ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₁)).hom a := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  have e₂ : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b)
      = (w.appLE U₂ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₂)).hom b := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  -- the unit factor: pullback of the inverse transport is restriction
  have hu := congrArg Units.val
    (Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_unitsPreimageEquiv_symm w hWrange
      (le_rfl : w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V) ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v))
  rw [Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at hu
  -- conclude by injectivity of pullback onto the preimage of the image open
  have key : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a)
      = (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
        ((((Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv w hWrange).symm (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v)) :
            Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V))
          * (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b) := by
    rw [map_mul]
    exact e₁.trans (hres.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) hu.symm e₂.symm))
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl)).injective key

end Hom

/-! ## The `hreg` discharge along an open immersion -/

namespace LocalEquations

/-- **Pullback regularity is automatic along an open immersion**: the germs of the
pulled-back equations of any local-equation system are nonzerodivisors — the `hreg`
discharge of `LocalEquations.pullback` needs no certificate when the comparison is an
open immersion, since its stalk comparisons are isomorphisms. -/
theorem germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion {Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w] (d : Y.LocalEquations) (y z : Z)
    (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback w).opens y) :
    (Z.presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) z hz).hom (pullbackEqn w d y)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z) := by
  -- the germ of the pulled equation is the stalk image of the germ of the equation
  have hres : (Z.presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) z hz).hom
      (pullbackEqn w d y)
      = (Z.presheaf.germ (w ⁻¹ᵁ d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz).hom
        ((w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y))).hom (d.eqn (w.base y))) := by
    rw [pullbackEqn]
    rw [show w.appLE (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) le_rfl
        = w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app w]
    rfl
  have hpush : (Z.presheaf.germ (w ⁻¹ᵁ d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz).hom
      ((w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y))).hom (d.eqn (w.base y)))
      = (w.stalkMap z).hom
        (((Y.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) (w.base z) hz).hom
          (d.eqn (w.base y)))) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply w (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz
      (d.eqn (w.base y))).symm
  rw [hres, hpush]
  set e := (asIso (w.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  exact equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors e (d.regular (w.base y) (w.base z) hz)

end LocalEquations

end Scheme

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-! ## Divisor equality of local-equation systems (the setoid relation)

Generic in the scheme; this is pure `DivisorClass`-level material. -/

namespace Scheme.LocalEquations

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
private lemma res_res {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

/-- **Divisor equality** of two local-equation systems: on a common refinement of the
two covers, the equations agree up to a unit at every point — common refinement plus
unit rescaling in a single move (the `CechPic`-pattern setoid of the DD-1 spec). -/
def DivEq (d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations) : Prop :=
  ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ d₁.cover) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ d₂.cover),
    ∀ x : X, ∃ u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ,
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁ x)).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
        = (u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x))
          * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂ x)).op).hom (d₂.eqn x)

lemma divEq_refl (d : X.LocalEquations) : DivEq d d :=
  ⟨d.cover, le_rfl, le_rfl, fun _ => ⟨1, by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩⟩

lemma DivEq.symm {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) : DivEq d₂ d₁ := by
  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
  refine ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
  exact ⟨u⁻¹, by
    rw [hu, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩

lemma DivEq.trans {d₁ d₂ d₃ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) (h' : DivEq d₂ d₃) :
    DivEq d₁ d₃ := by
  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨𝒱, k₂, k₃, K⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒱, fun x => (inf_le_left (b := 𝒱.opens x)).trans (h₁ x),
    fun x => (inf_le_right (a := 𝒲.opens x)).trans (k₃ x), fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := K x
  have E1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
    (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom hu
  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E1

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffSwallow
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.PiLocalization
8	
9	/-!
10	# The glued clauses on a straddling cover: (c2)/(c3)/(c4) REDUCE to (c1)
11	
12	The corrected cert-collapse claim (roadmap `...certificate.cert-collapse`, as amended after
13	the I-0340 refutation), carried out on the widened cover.
14	
15	## What was refuted and what survives
16	
17	The refuted claim was that (c2)/(c3)/(c4) are FREE for a swallow-or-miss adaptation.  They are
18	not, and `DivisorFamilyAffCollapse.lean` kernel-checks why: `toOvlLeft i i = toOvlRight i i`
19	by `rfl`, so every diagonal component of `deltaLeft - deltaRight` vanishes for EVERY
20	adaptation, and the diagonal factor always survives in the cokernel.  Clause (c4) therefore
21	always implies flatness of the diagonal overlap colengths — no structural observation about
22	which pieces meet the support can remove that.
23	
24	What survives is the REDUCTION the amended node states: on a cover with a straddling piece,
25	(c2)/(c3)/(c4) follow from (c1)-projectivity alone.  This file proves it.
26	
27	## The mechanism, and it is sharper than the node's account
28	
29	With a straddling piece `j₀`, every OTHER piece misses the support, so
30	`subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint` kills every overlap colength that involves an index
31	`≠ j₀` — in particular every OFF-DIAGONAL one, since a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least
32	one entry `≠ j₀`.  Combined with the vanishing diagonal, `deltaLeft - deltaRight` is the ZERO
33	map (`deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy`).  Hence:
34	
35	* `gluedSubmodule = ⊤`, so `Glued ≃ chartProd` — (c2) becomes a statement about the product of
36	  the piece colengths, of which all but one are subsingleton;
37	* `chartProd ⧸ gluedSubmodule` is subsingleton, so (c3) is free — and this IS free, with no
38	  input, which is the one part of the original claim that was right;
39	* `range (deltaLeft - deltaRight) = ⊥`, so the (c4) cokernel is `ovlProd` itself, whose
40	  factors are the overlap colengths: all subsingleton except `ovlColength j₀ j₀`.  So (c4)
41	  reduces to flatness of THAT ONE module — exactly the residue the refutation predicted, now
42	  isolated to a single index instead of a whole cover.
43	
44	## Main declarations
45	
46	* `AffAdaptation.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy` — the difference arrow vanishes identically.
47	* `AffAdaptation.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy` — the equalizer is everything.
48	* `AffAdaptation.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy` — hence `Glued ≃ₗ chartProd`.
49	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c3), unconditionally free.
50	* `AffAdaptation.ovlColengthDiagEquiv` — the diagonal overlap colength IS the piece colength
51	  (the cert-collapse node's "one technical lemma still needed", in the diagonal case).
52	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c4) from (c1)-flatness alone.
53	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` — **the capstone**: the whole certificate
54	  from (c1) plus the rank datum.
55	
56	## The upshot for the roadmap
57	
58	`isCertified_of_swallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) takes FIVE glued hypotheses.
59	On a straddling cover none of them is needed: `isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` takes (c1)
60	finiteness and projectivity, plus `hrank`, and produces all seven clauses.  `hrank` is the
61	honest content of "the divisor has degree `n`" and cannot come from anywhere else.
62	
63	That is the corrected cert-collapse claim, discharged.  Note what it does NOT do: it does not
64	contradict the I-0340 refutation.  (c4) still *implies* flatness of the diagonal overlap
65	colengths — the refutation is a theorem.  What the straddling shape adds is that this
66	implication is now harmless, because on the diagonal that flatness IS (c1)-flatness, which the
67	fibrewise input already supplies.  The refutation said "(c4) is not free"; it is still not
68	free, it is just no longer an extra assumption.
69	-/
70	
71	set_option autoImplicit false
72	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
73	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
74	/- The three `simpa using congrFun …` steps below genuinely need `simpa`: the linter's
75	suggested `simp using` is not a tactic, and plain `exact` fails because the coerced presheaf
76	map has to be normalized before the two sides match. -/
77	set_option linter.unnecessarySimpa false
78	
79	universe u
80	
81	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
82	
83	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
84	
85	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
86	
87	namespace AffAdaptation
88	
89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
90	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
91	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
92	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d)
93	
94	/-! ## Every overlap colength off the straddling diagonal vanishes -/
95	
96	/-- **An overlap involving a missing piece has vanishing colength.**  `SwallowedBy` says every
97	piece other than `j₀` is disjoint from the support, and an overlap is contained in each of its
98	two pieces, so it too misses the support. -/
99	lemma subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy {j₀ : D.index}
100	    (hmiss : ∀ j : D.index, j ≠ j₀ →
101	      Disjoint d.supportLocus (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
102	    (i j : D.index) (h : i ≠ j₀ ∨ j ≠ j₀) :
103	    Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
104	  refine A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint i j fun z hz hsupp => ?_
105	  rcases h with hi | hj
106	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss i hi)) hsupp hz.1
107	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz.2
108	
109	/-- **The difference arrow is identically zero on a straddling cover.**  On the diagonal it
110	vanishes for every adaptation whatsoever (`deltaSub_apply_diag`, the I-0340 fact); off the
111	diagonal the target is subsingleton, because a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least one
112	entry different from the straddling index. -/
113	theorem deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
114	    A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight = 0 := by
115	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
116	  refine LinearMap.ext fun s => funext fun p => ?_
117	  by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
118	  · -- diagonal: zero for every adaptation, by proof irrelevance on `inf_le_left/right`
119	    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
120	    cases hp
121	    exact A.deltaSub_apply_diag s i
122	  · -- off-diagonal: at least one index misses the support, so the target is trivial
123	    haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) := by
124	      by_cases h1 : p.1 = j₀
125	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2
126	          (Or.inr fun h2 => hp (h1.trans h2.symm))
127	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2 (Or.inl h1)
128	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
129	
130	/-! ## The consequences for (c2)/(c3)/(c4) -/
131	
132	/-- **The equalizer is everything**: with the difference arrow zero, every section glues. -/
133	theorem gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
134	    A.gluedSubmodule = ⊤ := by
135	  rw [gluedSubmodule, A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]
136	  exact LinearMap.ker_zero
137	
138	/-- **Hence the glued module is the whole product of piece colengths.**  This is what makes
139	(c2) a statement about the piece colengths — of which, on a straddling cover, all but the
140	swallowing one are subsingleton. -/
141	noncomputable def gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
142	    A.Glued ≃ₗ[R] A.chartProd :=
143	  (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h)).trans
144	    Submodule.topEquiv
145	
146	/-- **Clause (c3) is free on a straddling cover** — no fibrewise input, no Noetherian
147	hypothesis, nothing.  The inclusion `W(d) ↪ ∏ colength` is onto, so its cokernel is trivial.
148	This is the one part of this leaf's refuted original claim that was correct. -/
149	theorem flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
150	    Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
151	  haveI : Subsingleton (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
152	    rw [A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h]; infer_instance
153	  haveI : Module.Free R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
154	    Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
155	  exact Module.Flat.of_free
156	
157	/-- **Clause (c2)-finiteness reduces to the piece colengths.** -/
158	theorem finite_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
159	    (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) :
160	    Module.Finite R A.Glued := by
161	  haveI := hfin
162	  haveI : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
163	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
164	
165	/-- **Clause (c2)-projectivity reduces to the piece colengths.**  The index is a `Fin`, so the
166	product is the direct sum and `Module.Projective.directSum` applies. -/
167	theorem projective_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
168	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
169	    Module.Projective R A.Glued := by
170	  haveI := hproj
171	  haveI : Module.Projective R A.chartProd :=
172	    Module.Projective.of_equiv
173	      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R D.index A.colength)
174	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
175	
176	/-! ### The diagonal overlap IS the piece colength
177	
178	The identification the cert-collapse node calls "the one technical lemma still needed", in the
179	only case the straddling shape leaves: the diagonal.  It is easier there than in general
180	(`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` needs no unit argument, only `inf_idem`) but it is NOT
181	definitional — `Γ(pieces i ⊓ pieces i)` and `Γ(pieces i)` are different types, which is the
182	`inf`-bookkeeping hazard the node flags.  So it goes through a genuine algebra equivalence. -/
183	
184	/-- The opens-level idempotence, named so the transports below can rewrite with it. -/
185	lemma pieces_inf_self (i : D.index) : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i = D.pieces i := inf_idem _
186	
187	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  Restriction along
188	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` is an algebra isomorphism carrying the overlap ideal — whose
189	two generators coincide there — onto `span {eqn i}`. -/
190	noncomputable def sectionsInfSelfEquiv (i : D.index) :
191	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i) ≃ₐ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i) where
192	  toFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm)
193	  invFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i))
194	  left_inv := fun x => by
195	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
196	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
197	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
198	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
199	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
200	  right_inv := fun x => by
201	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
202	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
203	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
204	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
205	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
206	  map_mul' := map_mul _
207	  map_add' := map_add _
208	  commutes' := AlgHom.commutes _
209	
210	@[simp]
211	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_apply (i : D.index)
212	    (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i)) :
213	    sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i x
214	      = relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm) x := rfl
215	
216	/-- **Restricting to the diagonal overlap and coming back is the identity.**  Stated as a
217	`simp` lemma because the two coercions (`AlgEquiv` vs the `RingHom` that `Ideal.map` takes)
218	are not syntactically equal, so `rw` cannot use the unstated form. -/

/-! ## Local equations -/

/-- Local equations for an effective Cartier divisor on `X`, adapted to a pointed cover:
a section `eqn x` on each member `cover.opens x`, whose germ at every point of that member
is a nonzerodivisor (`regular`) and whose overlap ratios `eqn x / eqn y` are units
(`ratio_isUnit`). The class of the associated Čech cocycle of transition units is the
divisor class `𝒪(D)`, see `LocalEquations.picClass`. -/
structure LocalEquations (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where

  cover : X.PointedCover
  /-- The local equation on the member `cover.opens x`. -/
  eqn : ∀ x, Γ(X, cover.opens x)
  /-- Each local equation is regular: its germ at every point of its member is a
  nonzerodivisor in the stalk. This is the primitive form of regularity; it implies the
  regularity of every restriction (`eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors`). -/

137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>

139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))

142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by

144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra

183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),

187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])

216	/-! ## The locally certified divisor-functor value -/
217	
218	variable (C R π)
219	variable (n : ℕ)
220	
221	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on locally certified systems (Addendum 2's mirror of
222	`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
223	certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
224	def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
225	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
226	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
227	  iseqv :=
228	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
229	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
230	
231	/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
232	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
233	degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
234	a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
235	def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
236	
237	namespace DivFamZar
238	
239	variable {C R π n}
240	
241	/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
242	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
243	    DivFamZar C R π n :=
244	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩
245	
246	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
247	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
248	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
249	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
250	
251	/-- **The Picard class of a locally certified divisor class** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on
252	the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/
253	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
254	  Quotient.lift
255	    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
256	      d.1.picClass)
257	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
258	
259	@[simp]
260	lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
261	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
262	  rfl
263	
264	end DivFamZar
265	
266	variable {C R π n}
267	
268	/-- **The comparison from the globally certified value**: a certified family is
269	locally certified (trivial cover), and divisor equality is the relation on both
270	sides. Over a field the two notions agree; over a general base `toZar` is the
271	sheafification-of-value comparison. -/
272	def DivFam.toZar : DivFam C R π n → DivFamZar C R π n :=
273	  Quotient.lift
274	    (fun F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n =>
275	      DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified)
276	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr h)
277	
278	@[simp]
279	lemma DivFam.toZar_mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) :
280	    (DivFam.mk F).toZar = DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified :=
281	  rfl
282	
283	/-- The Picard class factors through `toZar`. -/
284	@[simp]
285	lemma DivFamZar.picClass_toZar (F : DivFam C R π n) :
286	    F.toZar.picClass = F.picClass := by
287	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
288	  | h F => rfl
289	
290	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarGlueKit
7	
8	/-!
9	# Zariski gluing of locally certified divisor classes (DD-2 stage S5b keystone)
10	
11	**The pinned keystone** `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
12	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 — now TRUE at the locally certified level):
13	compatible locally certified divisor classes over a finite away cover of `R` glue to
14	a class over `R` restricting to them.
15	
16	Route: representatives `d i` carry local certificate covers `h i : Fin (m i) → S i`
17	with certified families `G i l` over `Localization.Away (h i l)`. The composite cover
18	`r ⟨i, l⟩ := a i l * g i` (numerators `a i l` of the `h i l`,
19	`IsLocalization.Away.sec`) spans `⊤` (`span_range_num_mul_eq_top`), and the fine
20	carriers `Localization.Away (h i l)` are `r ⟨i, l⟩`-away localizations of `R`
21	(`IsLocalization.Away.of_associated` + `IsLocalization.Away.mul`). The fine overlap
22	carriers `Localization.Away (algebraMap R _ (r q))` receive the coarse overlap
23	carriers `T i j` by `IsLocalization.Away.lift`; the fine compatibility follows from
24	the class-level compatibility pulled to the fine overlaps through the two
25	factorizations of each comparison (witness transport, the composite collapse
26	`divEq_pullback_pullback`, and the mapAlg-hreg engine for every regularity
27	side-condition). The certified-input gluing core
28	(`DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_certified_away_compat`) then produces the glued class, and
29	the restriction law at the coarse level follows by Zariski separation
30	(`DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq`) over each `S i` against its fine cover.
31	-/
32	
33	set_option autoImplicit false
34	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling
35	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
36	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
37	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
38	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
40	
41	universe u
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
44	open Opposite
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
49	
50	/-- Bottom face of a triple tower: `R₀ → A → D` commutes when `R₀ → A → B`,
51	`R₀ → B → D` and `A → B → D` do. -/
52	private lemma isScalarTower_bot {R₀ A B D : Type u} [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A]
53	    [CommRing B] [CommRing D] [Algebra R₀ A] [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra R₀ D]
54	    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D]
55	    [IsScalarTower R₀ A B] [IsScalarTower R₀ B D] [IsScalarTower A B D] :
56	    IsScalarTower R₀ A D :=
57	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
58	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ B D, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ A B,
59	      ← RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D])
60	
61	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
62	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
63	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
64	
65	/-- **THE PINNED KEYSTONE — Zariski gluing of locally certified divisor classes**
66	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): for a finite span-⊤ family `g : ι → R` with
67	away carriers `S i` and overlap carriers `T i j`, locally certified classes
68	`F i : DivFamZar C (S i) π n` compatible on the overlaps glue: there is
69	`F₀ : DivFamZar C R π n` with `DivFamZar.mapAlg (S i) n F₀ = F i` for all `i`.
70	(Uniqueness is `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq`.) -/
71	theorem DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat
72	    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R) (S : ι → Type u)
73	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]

107	/-- **The composite-cover span** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): for a span-⊤
108	family `g : ι → R` with away carriers `S i`, span-⊤ families `h i` on the `S i`, and
109	numerators `a i l` of the `h i l` (their images associated to the `h i l`), the
110	products `a i l * g i` span the unit ideal of `R`. Prime avoidance: a prime `M`
111	missing some `g i` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
112	(`PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range`); `Q` misses some `h i l`, hence `M`
113	misses the numerator `a i l`, hence the product. -/
114	theorem span_range_num_mul_eq_top {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R)
115	    (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
116	    [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
117	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
118	    {m : ι → ℕ} (h : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → S i)
119	    (hspan : ∀ i, Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) = ⊤)
120	    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → R)
121	    (hassoc : ∀ i l, Associated (algebraMap R (S i) (a i l)) (h i l)) :
122	    Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : Σ i, Fin (m i) => a p.1 p.2 * g p.1) = ⊤ := by
123	  by_contra hne
124	  obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
125	  haveI hMprime : M.IsPrime := hMmax.isPrime
126	  -- some `g i` avoids `M`
127	  obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ : ∃ i, g i ∉ M := by
128	    by_contra hall
129	    push Not at hall
130	    have hM : Ideal.span (Set.range g) ≤ M := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
131	      rintro - ⟨i, rfl⟩
132	      exact hall i)
133	    rw [hg] at hM
134	    exact hMmax.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hM)
135	  -- `M` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
136	  have hmem : (⟨M, hMprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)
137	      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (S i))) := by
138	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S i) (g i)]
139	    exact hgi
140	  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmem
141	  have hQM : Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (S i)) = M :=
142	    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hQ
143	  -- some `h i l` avoids `Q`
144	  obtain ⟨l, hhl⟩ : ∃ l, h i l ∉ Q.asIdeal := by
145	    by_contra hall
146	    push Not at hall
147	    have hQ' : Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) ≤ Q.asIdeal := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
148	      rintro - ⟨l, rfl⟩
149	      exact hall l)
150	    rw [hspan i] at hQ'
151	    exact Q.isPrime.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hQ')
152	  -- the numerator avoids `M`
153	  have hal : a i l ∉ M := by
154	    intro hmem'
155	    have h1 : algebraMap R (S i) (a i l) ∈ Q.asIdeal :=
156	      Ideal.mem_comap.mp (hQM.symm ▸ hmem')
157	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc i l
158	    exact hhl (hu ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_right (u : S i) Q.asIdeal h1)
159	  -- primality contradiction on the product
160	  have hmemM : a i l * g i ∈ M := hle (Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨i, l⟩, rfl⟩)
161	  rcases hMprime.mem_or_mem hmemM with hc | hc
162	  · exact hal hc
163	  · exact hgi hc

186	    [∀ p q, IsScalarTower R (S' p) (V p q)] [∀ p q, IsScalarTower R (S' q) (V p q)]
187	    [∀ p q, IsLocalization.Away (r p * r q) (V p q)]

7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZar
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertZarPointwise
9	
10	/-!
11	# The widened `DivFamZar` (R2, human decision I-0492)
12	
13	The endpoint of the widening.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` is the locally-certified predicate
14	whose local certificates are carried by **arbitrary affine-open covers** rather than by basic
15	opens of a fixed pair of pinned `P¹` charts, and `DivFamZarAff` is its `DivEq` quotient —
16	the object the human decision of 2026-07-28 is about.
17	
18	## Why this is strictly weaker than the old predicate, which is the whole point
19	
20	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) turns every old cover datum into
21	a widened one, and `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean` migrates the CERTIFICATE on top of it, so
22	`isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified` holds: anything the old
23	predicate certified, the new one certifies.  The converse fails, and its failure is exactly
24	the content of R2 — a divisor straddling both pinned vertical fibres has no chart-typed
25	certificate (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 4 §4.3, on-stratum witness at every `g ≥ 2`)
26	but does admit an affine-open one, because `supp D` is finite over `R` and therefore lies in a
27	single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`).
28	
29	So `DivFamZarAff` is the value on which the divisor functor can be a Zariski sheaf over an
30	ARBITRARY field, with no `|P¹(k)| ≥ n + 2` hypothesis anywhere — the field-uniform fix.
31	
32	## The two relocated obligations (I-0492 clause 4)
33	
34	* **(i) fibrewise-finite support.** NOT a field of anything here.  It is not implied by
35	  what a `LocalEquations` carries (`d.eqn ≡ r` for a non-unit `r ∈ R` is germ-regular with a
36	  whole fibre curve in its support), so it must come from the seed's own degree data.  It
37	  enters as an explicit hypothesis at the point of use, never as carrier data: concretely as
38	  the `hfib` argument of `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy`
39	  (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) and as `AffCoverData.SwallowedBy`
40	  (`DivisorFamilyAffSwallow.lean`).  Neither is a field of anything in this file.
41	* **(ii) what the fixed-pair confinement was silently supplying.** Discharged in
42	  `DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean` (`exists_mem_pieces` from the joint cover,
43	  `flat_sections_pieces` from the flat structure morphism) and in
44	  `DivisorFamilyAffPerPiece.lean` (the whole per-piece layer, from openness and affineness).
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff` — a certified family over a widened cover.
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertifiedAff` — the widened locally-certified predicate.
50	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq` — it respects divisor equality.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff` — the widened functor value, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`
52	  and `picClass`.
53	
54	The comparison with the chart-typed predicate — `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified`
55	and `DivFamZar.toAff` — is in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`, which imports this file.
56	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away` — the pointwise gate,
57	  one base point at a time, over the widened predicate.
58	-/

76	/-! ## Certified families over a widened cover -/
77	
78	/-- **A certified divisor family of degree `n` over a widened cover**: a local-equation
79	system, an affine-open cover datum, an adaptation, and the certificate.  The cover is part of
80	the data (it is chosen per family), exactly as the old `adaptation` field bundled its own
81	`FinCoverData`. -/
82	structure CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff (n : ℕ) : Type u where
83	  /-- The local-equation system on the relative curve. -/
84	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
85	  /-- The affine-open cover carrying the certificate. -/
86	  cover : AffCoverData C R
87	  /-- The adaptation of the system to that cover. -/
88	  adaptation : AffAdaptation cover eqns
89	  /-- The colength certificate of degree `n`. -/
90	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n

92	/-! ## The widened locally-certified predicate -/
93	
94	variable {C R}
95	
96	/-- **The widened locally-certified pin.**  Identical in shape to `IsLocallyCertified`
97	(`DivisorFamilyZar.lean`) — a span-`⊤` family `g : Fin m → R` with certified families over
98	the away localizations, divisor-equal to the pulled system — except that the local
99	certificates live over ARBITRARY AFFINE-OPEN covers.
100	
101	The base-side structure is untouched on purpose: R2 widens where the pieces live on the
102	CURVE, and changes nothing about the Zariski cover of the base. -/
103	def IsLocallyCertifiedAff (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
104	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
105	    ∀ i : Fin m,
106	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
107	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
108	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away (g i)) n,
109	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
110	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
111	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
112	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
113	
114	/-- **The widened pin respects divisor equality** — the local `DivEq`s transport through
115	`divEq_pullback`, verbatim as in the chart-typed case. -/
116	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
118	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d' := by
119	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
120	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
121	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
122	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
123	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
124	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
125	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
126	      h _ _)⟩

128	/-! ## The comparison with the chart-typed predicate
129	
130	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) already migrates the COVER
131	sorry-free, and the adaptation's equations and `eqn_rel` transport with it because the pieces
132	are literally the same opens, only reindexed along `finSumFinEquiv`.
133	
134	The migration of the CERTIFICATE is landed too, in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`
135	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff`, all seven clauses).  Clauses (c1) are `rfl` at the
136	relabelled index; the glued clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transport along `LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft`
137	in its `symm` direction, which evaluates cast-free, so the intertwining with
138	`deltaLeft`/`deltaRight` is componentwise and `Module.rankAtStalk` invariance is
139	`rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv`.  No clause changes, only the index does.
140	
141	A predecessor docstring here estimated that transport at about a hundred lines of equalizer
142	bookkeeping.  That was wrong by an order of magnitude and the reason generalises: arrange the

/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
private lemma res_res {X : Scheme.{u}} {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

/-- A ring isomorphism carries nonzerodivisors to nonzerodivisors. -/
private lemma equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) : e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at ha ⊢
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ha
  constructor
  · intro b hb
    have h := congrArg e.symm hb
    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    have hb0 : e.symm b = 0 := hl _ h
    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]
  · intro b hb
    have h := congrArg e.symm hb
    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    have hb0 : e.symm b = 0 := hr _ h
    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]

/-! ## The unit-spreading engine (regularity gluing) -/

/-- **The unit-spreading engine** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5, the S1c
`eqn_ratio_isUnit` shape stated once for reuse): if `t` has nonzerodivisor germs on `V`
and, on a neighbourhood of every point of `V`, `s` is a unit multiple of `t`, then `s`
is a unit multiple of `t` on all of `V`.  The local cofactors are unique by regularity,
so they glue by the sheaf property (`Scheme.mem_span_singleton_of_forall_germ`); the
glued cofactor has unit germs at every point, hence is a unit
(`RingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ`). -/
theorem exists_unit_mul_of_locally_unit_mul {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens} {s t : Γ(X, V)}
    (ht : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ∈ V),
      (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk z))
    (h : ∀ (z : X) (_ : z ∈ V), ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V) (_ : z ∈ W)
      (u : Γ(X, W)ˣ),
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom s
        = (u : Γ(X, W)) * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom t) :
    ∃ u : Γ(X, V)ˣ, s = (u : Γ(X, V)) * t := by
  -- the germ of `s` is a unit multiple of the germ of `t` at every point of `V`
  have hgerm : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ∈ V), ∃ w : (X.presheaf.stalk z)ˣ,
      (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s
        = (w : X.presheaf.stalk z) * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hzW, u, hu⟩ := h z hz
    have hg := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ W z hzW).hom hu
    rw [map_mul, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hg
    exact ⟨(u.isUnit.map (X.presheaf.germ W z hzW).hom).unit, by
      rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact hg⟩
  -- glue the local cofactors: `s ∈ (t)`
  have hmem : s ∈ Ideal.span {t} := by
    refine Scheme.mem_span_singleton_of_forall_germ ht fun z hz => ?_
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgerm z hz
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨w, hw.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  -- the glued cofactor has unit germs, hence is a unit
  have hcunit : IsUnit c := by
    apply X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgerm z hz
    have hct : (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom c * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t
        = (w : X.presheaf.stalk z) * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t := by
      rw [← map_mul, hc]
      exact hw
    have hcw := (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (ht z hz)).mp hct
    rw [hcw]
    exact w.isUnit
  exact ⟨hcunit.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact hc.symm⟩

lemma appIso_inv_appLE_apply (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w] {V V' : Z.Opens}
    (e : V' ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (s : Γ(Z, V)) :
    (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) V' e).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      = (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by rwa [w.preimage_image_eq] at e)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_appLE]

/-- **Germ regularity transports along the immersion section transport**: if all germs
of `s` on `V` are nonzerodivisors, so are all germs of the transported section on the
image open `w ''ᵁ V` — the stalk comparison of an open immersion is an isomorphism. -/
theorem germ_appIso_inv_mem_nonZeroDivisors (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w]
    {V : Z.Opens} {s : Γ(Z, V)}
    (hs : ∀ (z : Z) (hz : z ∈ V),
      (Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z))
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ w ''ᵁ V) :
    (Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) y hy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hzy : w.base z ∈ w ''ᵁ V := (Scheme.Hom.apply_mem_image_iff w).mpr hz
  -- push the germ through the stalk comparison of the immersion
  have hpush : (w.stalkMap z).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) (w.base z) hzy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s))
      = (Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_app_apply]
    rw [show eqToHom (w.preimage_image_eq V)
        = homOfLE (w.preimage_image_eq V).le from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    rw [Z.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  -- transfer nonzerodivisibility along the stalk isomorphism
  set e := (asIso (w.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  have hval : (Y.presheaf.germ (w ''ᵁ V) (w.base z) hzy).hom ((w.appIso V).inv.hom s)
      = e.symm ((Z.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s) := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hpush
  have hmem := equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors e.symm (hs z hz)
  rw [← hval] at hmem
  exact hmem

/-- **Open-immersion unit descent, section form** (the S4
`exists_unit_of_pullback_unit` engine freed of the `LocalEquations` carrier,
`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): a unit relation between the `appLE` pullbacks of two
sections `a`, `b` on an open `V` below both preimages descends to a unit relation
between their restrictions on the image open `w ''ᵁ V`.  The unit is the inverse
transport of `v` through the section retraction of the immersion
(`Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv`); the identity is checked after pulling back to
`w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)`, where pullback of sections is bijective. -/
theorem exists_unit_res_of_appLE_eq_unit_mul (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w]
    {U₁ U₂ : Y.Opens} (a : Γ(Y, U₁)) (b : Γ(Y, U₂)) {V : Z.Opens}
    (hV₁ : V ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ U₁) (hV₂ : V ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ U₂)
    (hW₁ : w ''ᵁ V ≤ U₁) (hW₂ : w ''ᵁ V ≤ U₂) (v : Γ(Z, V)ˣ)
    (hv : (w.appLE U₁ V hV₁).hom a = (v : Γ(Z, V)) * (w.appLE U₂ V hV₂).hom b) :
    ∃ u : Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V)ˣ,
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a
        = (u : Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V)) * (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b := by
  have hWrange : w ''ᵁ V ≤ w.opensRange := w.image_le_opensRange V
  have hpre : w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V) ≤ V := (w.preimage_image_eq V).le
  haveI := Scheme.Hom.isIso_appLE_of_le_opensRange w hWrange
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv w hWrange).symm (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v), ?_⟩
  -- restrict the pulled relation to the preimage of the image open
  have h₁ : (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom ((w.appLE U₁ V hV₁).hom a)
      = (w.appLE U₁ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₁)).hom a := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  have h₂ : (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom ((w.appLE U₂ V hV₂).hom b)
      = (w.appLE U₂ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₂)).hom b := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  have hres := congrArg (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hpre).op).hom hv
  rw [map_mul, h₁, h₂] at hres
  -- both restricted sections pull back to `appLE` of the originals
  have e₁ : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a)
      = (w.appLE U₁ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₁)).hom a := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  have e₂ : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b)
      = (w.appLE U₂ (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (hpre.trans hV₂)).hom b := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  -- the unit factor: pullback of the inverse transport is restriction
  have hu := congrArg Units.val
    (Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_unitsPreimageEquiv_symm w hWrange
      (le_rfl : w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V) ≤ w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v))
  rw [Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at hu
  -- conclude by injectivity of pullback onto the preimage of the image open
  have key : (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₁).op).hom a)
      = (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom
        ((((Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv w hWrange).symm (Z.unitsRestrict hpre v)) :
            Γ(Y, w ''ᵁ V))
          * (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₂).op).hom b) := by
    rw [map_mul]
    exact e₁.trans (hres.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) hu.symm e₂.symm))
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (w.appLE (w ''ᵁ V) (w ⁻¹ᵁ (w ''ᵁ V)) le_rfl)).injective key

end Hom

/-! ## The `hreg` discharge along an open immersion -/

namespace LocalEquations

/-- **Pullback regularity is automatic along an open immersion**: the germs of the
pulled-back equations of any local-equation system are nonzerodivisors — the `hreg`
discharge of `LocalEquations.pullback` needs no certificate when the comparison is an
open immersion, since its stalk comparisons are isomorphisms. -/
theorem germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion {Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w] (d : Y.LocalEquations) (y z : Z)
    (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback w).opens y) :
    (Z.presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) z hz).hom (pullbackEqn w d y)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z) := by
  -- the germ of the pulled equation is the stalk image of the germ of the equation
  have hres : (Z.presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) z hz).hom
      (pullbackEqn w d y)
      = (Z.presheaf.germ (w ⁻¹ᵁ d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz).hom
        ((w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y))).hom (d.eqn (w.base y))) := by
    rw [pullbackEqn]
    rw [show w.appLE (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) ((d.cover.pullback w).opens y) le_rfl
        = w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app w]
    rfl
  have hpush : (Z.presheaf.germ (w ⁻¹ᵁ d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz).hom
      ((w.app (d.cover.opens (w.base y))).hom (d.eqn (w.base y)))
      = (w.stalkMap z).hom
        (((Y.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) (w.base z) hz).hom
          (d.eqn (w.base y)))) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply w (d.cover.opens (w.base y)) z hz
      (d.eqn (w.base y))).symm
  rw [hres, hpush]
  set e := (asIso (w.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  exact equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors e (d.regular (w.base y) (w.base z) hz)

end LocalEquations

end Scheme

end AlgebraicGeometry

11	/-!
12	# The widened divisor-functor map (R2, human decision I-0492)
13	
14	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` along an arbitrary test change `R → R'`, with the functor laws, the Abel
15	hook, and the Zariski separation keystone.  This is what makes the widened value a functor
16	VALUE rather than a bare type: before this file nothing could base-change a widened class.
17	
18	## Where the widening does and does not show
19	
20	Almost nowhere.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
21	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE, so the base-side machinery of
22	`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean` — the `Localization.Away` towers, `IsLocalization.map`,
23	`span_range_algebraMap_eq_top` — applies verbatim; the cover datum only appears inside the
24	opaque `mapAlg` of the local certified family.  Likewise
25	`Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback`, `divEq_pullback_id` and `divEq_pullback_pullback` are
26	stated for ARBITRARY scheme morphisms and know nothing about covers, so the functor laws are
27	the same three lines as in the chart-typed case.
28	
29	## The one honest cost of the widening: overlap affineness
30	
31	`AffCoverData` demands affineness of the pieces only (that is the R2 shape), so the certificate
32	transport takes an explicit `hinf` — the overlaps are affine.  A `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`
33	therefore cannot be base-changed without it, and rather than weaken the structure this file
34	carries `hinf` as a hypothesis on `mapAlg` at the family level.  It is not a hidden
35	assumption: it is visible in every signature below, as I-0492 clause 4 requires.  For a
36	relative curve over a proper `C` it is discharged by separatedness (`IsAffineOpen.inf`).
37	
38	## Main declarations
39	
40	* `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` — base change of a widened certified family.
41	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.pullback` — certificate transport along an arbitrary test change.
42	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg`, with `mapAlg_mk`, `picClass_mapAlg`, `mapAlg_id`, `mapAlg_comp`.
43	* `DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq` — Zariski separation at the widened Zar level.
44	-/
45	
46	set_option autoImplicit false
47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

50	universe u
51	
52	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
53	open Opposite TensorProduct

55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
56	
57	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

59	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
60	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
61	
62	/-- **Overlap affineness of a widened cover** — the one datum the certificate transport needs
63	beyond `AffCoverData`'s own fields.  Named so that it can be threaded explicitly and read off
64	any signature; for a relative curve over a proper `C` it follows from separatedness. -/
65	def AffCoverData.HasAffineOverlaps (D : AffCoverData C R) : Prop :=
66	  ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)

68	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
69	variable (n : ℕ)

71	/-- **Base change of a widened certified family**: pulled equations, base-changed cover and
72	adaptation, transported certificate. -/
73	noncomputable def CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R n)
74	    (hinf : F.cover.HasAffineOverlaps) : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R' n where
75	  eqns := F.adaptation.pulledEquations R' F.certified.projective_colength
76	  cover := F.cover.baseChange R'
77	  adaptation := F.adaptation.pullback R' F.certified.projective_colength

81	lemma CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg_cover (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R n)
82	    (hinf : F.cover.HasAffineOverlaps) :
83	    (F.mapAlg R' n hinf).cover = F.cover.baseChange R' := rfl

86	preimages of overlaps, and preimages of affine opens under `relCurveMap` are affine.  So the
87	`hinf` obligation propagates along a tower rather than accumulating. -/
88	theorem AffCoverData.hasAffineOverlaps_baseChange {D : AffCoverData C R}

90	  rw [show (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j

96	closed under intersection (`Over.isAffineOpen_inf`, via the affine diagonal).

101	theorem AffCoverData.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper [IsProper C.hom] (D : AffCoverData C R) :

107	/-- **Witness transport along a tower `R → A → B`**, widened: a certified family over `A`

112	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.divEq_mapAlg_pullback
113	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower k R A]
114	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B]
115	    [IsScalarTower k R B] [IsScalarTower k A B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
116	    (E : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C A n) (hinf : E.cover.HasAffineOverlaps)
117	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} {hregA} (hregB)
118	    (hdiv : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq E.eqns (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R A) hregA)) :
119	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq (E.mapAlg B n hinf).eqns
120	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R B) hregB) := by
121	  have hcomp : relCurveMap C A B ≫ relCurveMap C R A = relCurveMap C R B :=
122	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := A) (R'' := B)
123	  have hregMid := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
124	    (relCurveMap C A B) hdiv
125	    (E.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors B E.certified.projective_colength)
126	  exact Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.trans
127	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C A B) hdiv
128	      (E.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors B
129	        E.certified.projective_colength) hregMid)

135	locally certified system has regular pulled equations along an arbitrary test tower.
136	Regularity is germ-local on the curve, and the covering argument is on the BASE, so the proof

138	`CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`. -/

140	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
141	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
142	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R) n d)
143	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :

151	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>

153	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))

162	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover

164	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))

166	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
167	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
168	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz

193	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
194	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])

207	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d

220	/-! ## Certificate transport along an arbitrary test change
221	
222	`IsProper C.hom` from here on: it is what makes `HasAffineOverlaps` free
223	(`hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper`), so no `hinf` appears in any statement below.  The DD-R lane
224	has this hypothesis everywhere — the challenge curve is proper over `k`. -/
225	
226	section Transport
227	
228	variable [IsProper C.hom]
229	
230	/-- **Certificate transport, widened** (the S5b keystone at `DivFamZarAff`): the widened
231	locally-certified predicate is stable under an ARBITRARY test change `R → R'`.
232	
233	The base-side argument is untouched by the widening — the pushed cover `algebraMap R R' ∘ g`
234	spans `⊤` and the certified part over each `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` is
235	`mapAlg` of the local family — because R2 widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
236	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE.  Compare
237	`IsLocallyCertified.pullback` (`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean`): the proof is the same, with the
238	cover datum appearing only inside the opaque `mapAlg`. -/
239	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.pullback {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
240	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (hreg) :
241	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R') n
242	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg) := by
243	  classical
244	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
245	  have hloc' : IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R) n d := ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩
246	  refine ⟨m, fun i => algebraMap R R' (g i), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
247	  · have hrange : (Set.range fun i : Fin m => algebraMap R R' (g i))
248	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
249	      ext x
250	      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
251	        by rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
252	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
253	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
254	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
255	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
256	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
257	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) :=
258	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
259	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R' (g i))
260	  -- the induced away map as a local algebra tower
261	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i))
262	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
263	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i))
264	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
265	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R')
266	      (by
267	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
268	        use e
269	        simp)).toAlgebra
270	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i))
271	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
272	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
273	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
274	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
275	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i))
276	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
277	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
278	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i)),
279	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
280	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i))
281	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))),
282	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
283	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))])
284	  -- witness transport along `R → Localization.Away (g i) → the pushed chart`
285	  have hW := G.divEq_mapAlg_pullback n (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
286	    (G.cover.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper)
287	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
288	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) hGdiv
289	  -- the composite collapse through the `R'`-side factorization
290	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
291	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
292	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
293	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
294	  have hstep := Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback hcomp₂ d hreg
295	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
296	      (relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
297	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg))
298	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
299	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
300	  exact ⟨G.mapAlg (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) n
301	    (G.cover.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper), hW.trans hstep.symm⟩
302	
303	/-! ## The widened divisor-functor map -/
304	
305	/-- **The widened divisor-functor map on locally certified classes** along an ARBITRARY test
306	change: pull back the representative (the widened mapAlg-hreg engine discharges regularity) and
307	transport the certificates.  Well defined by `divEq_pullback`.
308	
309	With this, `DivFamZarAff` is a functor value: the field-uniform carrier of R2 base-changes
310	exactly as the chart-typed one did. -/
311	noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.mapAlg :
312	    DivFamZarAff C R n → DivFamZarAff C R' n :=

/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
private lemma res_res {X : Scheme.{u}} {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

/-- A ring isomorphism carries nonzerodivisors to nonzerodivisors. -/
private lemma equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) : e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at ha ⊢
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ha
  constructor
  · intro b hb
    have h := congrArg e.symm hb
    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    have hb0 : e.symm b = 0 := hl _ h
    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]
  · intro b hb
    have h := congrArg e.symm hb
    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    have hb0 : e.symm b = 0 := hr _ h
    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]

/-! ## The unit-spreading engine (regularity gluing) -/

/-- **The unit-spreading engine** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5, the S1c
`eqn_ratio_isUnit` shape stated once for reuse): if `t` has nonzerodivisor germs on `V`
and, on a neighbourhood of every point of `V`, `s` is a unit multiple of `t`, then `s`
is a unit multiple of `t` on all of `V`.  The local cofactors are unique by regularity,
so they glue by the sheaf property (`Scheme.mem_span_singleton_of_forall_germ`); the
glued cofactor has unit germs at every point, hence is a unit
(`RingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ`). -/
theorem exists_unit_mul_of_locally_unit_mul {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens} {s t : Γ(X, V)}
    (ht : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ∈ V),
      (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk z))
    (h : ∀ (z : X) (_ : z ∈ V), ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V) (_ : z ∈ W)
      (u : Γ(X, W)ˣ),
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom s
        = (u : Γ(X, W)) * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom t) :
    ∃ u : Γ(X, V)ˣ, s = (u : Γ(X, V)) * t := by
  -- the germ of `s` is a unit multiple of the germ of `t` at every point of `V`
  have hgerm : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ∈ V), ∃ w : (X.presheaf.stalk z)ˣ,
      (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom s
        = (w : X.presheaf.stalk z) * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hzW, u, hu⟩ := h z hz
    have hg := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ W z hzW).hom hu
    rw [map_mul, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hg
    exact ⟨(u.isUnit.map (X.presheaf.germ W z hzW).hom).unit, by
      rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact hg⟩
  -- glue the local cofactors: `s ∈ (t)`
  have hmem : s ∈ Ideal.span {t} := by
    refine Scheme.mem_span_singleton_of_forall_germ ht fun z hz => ?_
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgerm z hz
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨w, hw.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  -- the glued cofactor has unit germs, hence is a unit
  have hcunit : IsUnit c := by
    apply X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgerm z hz
    have hct : (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom c * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t
        = (w : X.presheaf.stalk z) * (X.presheaf.germ V z hz).hom t := by
      rw [← map_mul, hc]
      exact hw
    have hcw := (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (ht z hz)).mp hct
    rw [hcw]
    exact w.isUnit
  exact ⟨hcunit.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact hc.symm⟩

membership witness (public form of the S4 helper). -/

lemma appIso_inv_appLE_apply (w : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion w] {V V' : Z.Opens}

/-! ## Divisor equality of local-equation systems (the setoid relation)

Generic in the scheme; this is pure `DivisorClass`-level material. -/

namespace Scheme.LocalEquations

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
private lemma res_res {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

/-- **Divisor equality** of two local-equation systems: on a common refinement of the
two covers, the equations agree up to a unit at every point — common refinement plus
unit rescaling in a single move (the `CechPic`-pattern setoid of the DD-1 spec). -/
def DivEq (d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations) : Prop :=
  ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ d₁.cover) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ d₂.cover),
    ∀ x : X, ∃ u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ,
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁ x)).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
        = (u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x))
          * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂ x)).op).hom (d₂.eqn x)

lemma divEq_refl (d : X.LocalEquations) : DivEq d d :=
  ⟨d.cover, le_rfl, le_rfl, fun _ => ⟨1, by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩⟩

lemma DivEq.symm {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) : DivEq d₂ d₁ := by
  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
  refine ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
  exact ⟨u⁻¹, by
    rw [hu, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩

lemma DivEq.trans {d₁ d₂ d₃ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) (h' : DivEq d₂ d₃) :
    DivEq d₁ d₃ := by
  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨𝒱, k₂, k₃, K⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒱, fun x => (inf_le_left (b := 𝒱.opens x)).trans (h₁ x),
    fun x => (inf_le_right (a := 𝒲.opens x)).trans (k₃ x), fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := K x
  have E1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
    (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom hu
  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E1

end CertifiedDivisorFamily

/-- **The chart-typed pin implies the widened one.**  The base-side data `(m, g)` is reused
verbatim; only the curve-side certificate is migrated, and the divisor equality is literally
the same statement because `toAff` does not touch `eqns`.

The converse is FALSE, and that failure is the content of R2: a divisor straddling both pinned
vertical fibres has no chart-typed certificate (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 4 §4.3) but
does admit an affine-open one. -/
theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified {n : ℕ}
    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d := by
  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
  exact ⟨G.toAff, hGdiv⟩

/-- **The induced map of functor values** `DivFamZar → DivFamZarAff`: the widened value
receives every chart-typed class.  Well defined because the two setoids are the same
`DivEq` relation on the same underlying systems. -/
noncomputable def DivFamZar.toAff {n : ℕ} (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : DivFamZarAff C R n :=
  Quotient.liftOn F
    (fun dp => DivFamZarAff.mk dp.1 (isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified dp.2))
    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr h)

@[simp]
lemma DivFamZar.toAff_mk {n : ℕ} (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
    (DivFamZar.mk d hd).toAff
      = DivFamZarAff.mk d (isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified hd) :=
  rfl

/-- **The Picard class is unchanged by the widening** — the Abel hook DAT-C consumes the
same class whichever value it reads it from. -/
@[simp]
lemma DivFamZarAff.picClass_toAff {n : ℕ} (F : DivFamZar C R π n) :
    F.toAff.picClass = F.picClass := by
  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h dp => rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# Zariski gluing of the divisor functor: chart restriction and class assembly (DD-2 S5)
10	
11	The class-level half of the divisor-functor Zariski gluing
12	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5) on top of the glued local-equation system
13	`AlgebraicGeometry.awayGluedEquations`:
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations` — **chart restriction**: the
16	  pullback of the glued system along the open immersion `relCurveMap C R (S i)` is
17	  divisor-equal to the `i`-th local system.  The members and equations restrict back
18	  by construction (the immersion round trip); across the chart choice the pointwise
19	  cross units spread to the full overlaps by the Kit engines.
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFam.mapAlg_mk_eq_of_divEq_awayGluedEquations` — any certified
21	  family over `R` divisor-equal to the glued system restricts to the given classes
22	  under `DivFam.mapAlg`.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFam.exists_glue_of_away_compat_of_certifiedRep` — **the
24	  conditional keystone**: compatible classes over a finite covering family of
25	  localizations glue to a class over `R`, GIVEN a certified representative of the
26	  glued system.
27	
28	## The open certificate seam (the S5 wall, recorded)
29	
30	The unconditional keystone `DivFam.exists_glue_of_away_compat` needs a certified
31	adaptation over `R` of (a system divisor-equal to) `awayGluedEquations`.  The
32	spec-dd-2 §5 route — pieces = the `A_i`-pieces cleared of denominators
33	(`D(h̃·g̃ᵢᴺ)`), certificate by localization-span descent through the landed
34	base-change transports — is NOT viable: a cleared piece lies inside the `g̃ᵢ`-locus,
35	so its colength `Γ(D(h̃·g̃ᵢᴺ))⧸(f̃)` is a module over the localization `S i`, and its
36	further localization at `g j` (`j ≠ i`) is an `S i ⊗ S j`-module that is not finite
37	over `S j` (already for the zero-section divisor over `R = k[u]`, `g = (u, 1-u)`:
38	the cleared piece `D(ũ)` has colength `R_u`, and `(R_u)_{1-u}` is not module-finite
39	over `R_{1-u}`) — the hypotheses of `Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan`-shaped
40	descent fail, clause (c1) is false for such pieces.  A certified adaptation over `R`
41	must instead have pieces whose divisor traces are clopen in the divisor
42	(the `π`-fibre tri-partition of the divisor, whose clopenness IS Zariski-local and
43	descends from the `A_i`-certificates); building that extraction is a separate brick
44	— hence the certificate-provider hypothesis `hcert` below, which that brick will
45	discharge.  Uniqueness needs no condition (`DivFam.eq_of_away_eq`, S4).
46	-/

80	/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
81	private lemma res_res {X : Scheme.{u}} {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U)
82	    (s : Γ(X, U)) :
83	    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
84	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
85	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

87	@[simp]
88	lemma awayGluedEquations_cover_opens (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
89	    (hcompat : AwayCompatDivEq S E T) (y : relCurve C R) :
90	    (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.opens y
91	      = relCurveMap C R (S (awayGlueIndex g S hg y)) ''ᵁ
92	          (E (awayGlueIndex g S hg y)).eqns.cover.opens (awayGlueLift g S hg y) :=
93	  rfl

95	@[simp]
96	lemma awayGluedEquations_eqn (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
97	    (hcompat : AwayCompatDivEq S E T) (y : relCurve C R) :
98	    (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).eqn y
99	      = ((relCurveMap C R (S (awayGlueIndex g S hg y))).appIso
100	          ((E (awayGlueIndex g S hg y)).eqns.cover.opens
101	            (awayGlueLift g S hg y))).inv.hom
102	        ((E (awayGlueIndex g S hg y)).eqns.eqn (awayGlueLift g S hg y)) :=
103	  rfl
104	
105	/-- **Chart restriction of the glued system** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): the pullback
106	of `awayGluedEquations` along the open immersion `relCurveMap C R (S i)` is
107	divisor-equal to the `i`-th local system.  Pointwise: on the overlap of the glued
108	member with the image of the chart member, the transported equations differ by a unit
109	(the cross unit spread by the Kit engine), and the relation pulls back up the
110	immersion, where the transported equation restricts back to the chart equation (the
111	immersion round trip). -/
112	theorem divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
113	    (hcompat : AwayCompatDivEq S E T) (i : ι) (hreg) :
114	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
115	      ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).pullback (relCurveMap C R (S i)) hreg)
116	      (E i).eqns := by
117	  classical
118	  refine ⟨((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.pullback
119	      (relCurveMap C R (S i))) ⊓ (E i).eqns.cover,
120	    fun z' => inf_le_left, fun z' => inf_le_right, fun z' => ?_⟩
121	  -- the downstairs overlap of the glued member with the image of the chart member
122	  obtain ⟨uO, huO⟩ := Scheme.exists_unit_mul_of_locally_unit_mul
123	    (X := relCurve C R)
124	    (V := (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.opens
125	        ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')
126	      ⊓ relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z')
127	    (s := ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom
128	      ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).eqn ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')))
129	    (t := ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom
130	      (((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appIso ((E i).eqns.cover.opens z')).inv.hom
131	        ((E i).eqns.eqn z')))
132	    (fun z hz => by
133	      rw [(relCurve C R).presheaf.germ_res_apply]
134	      exact germ_awayTransport_mem_nonZeroDivisors S E i z' z hz.2)
135	    (fun z hz => by
136	      obtain ⟨W, hWO, hzW, u, hu⟩ := exists_res_awayTransport_eq_unit_mul g S E T
137	        hcompat
138	        (inf_le_left :
139	          (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.opens
140	              ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')
141	            ⊓ relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z' ≤ _)
142	        (inf_le_right :
143	          (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.opens
144	              ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')
145	            ⊓ relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z' ≤ _)
146	        z hz
147	      refine ⟨W, hWO, hzW, u, ?_⟩
148	      rw [res_res, res_res]
149	      exact hu)
150	  -- pull the overlap unit up the immersion
151	  have hpre : ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.pullback
152	        (relCurveMap C R (S i))).opens z' ⊓ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z'
153	      ≤ relCurveMap C R (S i) ⁻¹ᵁ
154	        ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.opens
155	            ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')
156	          ⊓ relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z') :=
157	    (relCurveMap C R (S i)).le_preimage_inf inf_le_left
158	      (inf_le_right.trans ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).preimage_image_eq _).ge)
159	  refine ⟨(relCurveMap C R (S i)).unitsAppLE _ _ hpre uO, ?_⟩
160	  -- transport the unit relation through `appLE`
161	  have hkey := congrArg ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appLE _ _ hpre).hom huO
162	  rw [map_mul] at hkey
163	  -- the left factor: the restricted pulled equation
164	  have hL : ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appLE _ _ hpre).hom
165	      (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom
166	        ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).eqn
167	          ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z')))
168	      = ((relCurve C (S i)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
169	          ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.pullback
170	              (relCurveMap C R (S i))).opens z' ⊓ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z'
171	            ≤ _)).op).hom
172	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R (S i))
173	          (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat) z') := by
174	    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE,
175	      Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn_res]
176	  -- the right factor: the immersion round trip back to the chart equation
177	  have hR : ((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appLE _ _ hpre).hom
178	      (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom
179	        (((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appIso ((E i).eqns.cover.opens z')).inv.hom
180	          ((E i).eqns.eqn z')))
181	      = ((relCurve C (S i)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
182	          ((awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat).cover.pullback
183	              (relCurveMap C R (S i))).opens z' ⊓ (E i).eqns.cover.opens z'
184	            ≤ _)).op).hom ((E i).eqns.eqn z') := by
185	    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE,
186	      Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_appLE_apply]
187	  rw [hL, hR] at hkey
188	  exact hkey
